mentions.name: BitGrid
mentions.description: A compute fabric project designed to be more power efficient than TPUs; after years of work the author concluded it can't reach that goal, though it could serve as a quite efficient FPGA-like compute fabric.
mentions.problem: The project aimed to achieve compute more power efficient than TPUs.
mentions.source_excerpt: my BitGrid project couldn't meet it's goal of being more power efficient than TPUs, but it took years to figure that out. It could be a quite efficient FPGA like compute fabric, but that's not something I'm super interested in right now.

evidence.value: my BitGrid project couldn't meet it's goal of being more power efficient than TPUs, but it took years to figure that out. It could be a quite efficient FPGA like compute fabric, but that's not something I'm super interested in right now.
